snippet.title: PAW Patrol: Grand Prix | Announce Trailer | PEGI
snippet.description: No track is too big, no racer too small! The PAW Patrol are back and ready for action on their fastest mission yet – To win the Pup Cup! Race around Adventure Bay and beyond with your favorite PAW Patrol characters! Buckle up for a PAWsome race & raise a 🐾 if you are as excited as we are! #PawPatrolGrandPrix Discover more:
